title: L1 literature sweep (2026-11-17): three new 2026 bilinear-Kloosterman bounds identified as the exact plug-point for moving the 4/7 wall (PRZZ Case-3 binding side) - Pascadi (GAFA 2026), Blomer-Pascadi (arXiv:2607.24311, c^-1/32 saving at length sqrt(c), all moduli including prime), arXiv:2601.00292 (Kloosterman fractions); the seven-term Deshouillers-Iwaniec Type II kernel of PRZZ section 4 extracted verbatim as the comparison target; the double-waste gate (LevWall7) any such estimate must pass is restated (BOTH Case-3 exponents must improve); NO RH CLAIM
facts: WHY THIS SWEEP: the in-tree wall map (0292-0304, machine in RhAttack.LevWall2/3/5/6/7) pins the exact published obstruction of the (1.2)-family wall {theta | theta > 4/7} as the SIMULTANEOUS saturation of PRZZ Theorem 4.1 Case-3 error exponents (7/4, 7/8) at N = T^theta (7/4 * 4/7 = 1 and 7/8 * 4/7 + 1/2 = 1, both = 1 at theta = 4/7). LevWall7's DOUBLE-WASTE THEOREM (machine): improving EITHER published error exponent ALONE, by any amount, does NOT move the wall (the unimproved term still binds at 4/7); under (delta, delta2) improvements of (7/4, 7/8) the wall moves to EXACTLY 4/7 + min(8*delta/7, 4*delta2/7). The N^{7/4} side - the BILINEAR KLOOSTERMAN (Type II, Deshouillers-Iwaniec Lemma 1) side - is the binding side; the L1 lever = a sharper bilinear Kloosterman estimate.

SWEEP RESULT (new since the 0300 sweep of 2026-11-11), three papers in the EXACT machinery class: (1) A. Pascadi, 'Non-Abelian Amplification and Bilinear Forms with Kloosterman Sums', Geom. Funct. Anal. (2026-08-21, Springer): a new method bounding bilinear (Type II) sums of Kloosterman sums with COMPOSITE moduli via Fourier analysis on SL2(Z/cZ) + non-abelian amplification; non-trivial bound for all moduli except near-primes at length sqrt(c). (2) V. Blomer & A. Pascadi, arXiv:2607.24311 (2026-07-27), 'Bilinear forms with Kloosterman sums via quadratic characters': new bounds VALID FOR ALL MODULI c; in the critical range (summation length ~ sqrt(c)) the saving over the trivial bound is c^(-1/32), 'improving on all previous approaches even for prime moduli'; applications to moments of twisted L-functions (the PRZZ moment class) and the large sieve for exceptional Maass forms; new connection to quadratic character sums. (3) arXiv:2601.00292 (2026-01), 'Bilinear forms with Kloosterman fractions and applications': new estimates for Type II bilinear forms with INCOMPLETE Kloosterman sums, improving the Fouvry-Kowalski-Michel / Blomer-Fouvry-Kowalski-Michel-Milicevic / Kowalski-Michel-Sawin / Shparlinski line; also bilinear forms with one variable from an arbitrary set.

THE COMPARISON TARGET (extracted verbatim from PRZZ arXiv:1802.10521 section 4, the Type II step of Theorem 4.1 Case 3): the Type II sum is sum_{|a|<A} nu(a) sum_{v ~ V, (v,h)=1} r(v) sum_{e ~ E, f ~ F, (ef,v)=1} alpha(e) beta(f) e(-a * hbar u / v) with EF ~ U and W << E << F << U W^{-1}, and the estimate used is Deshouillers-Iwaniec Lemma 1 (Acta Arith. 48 (1984)) giving the SEVEN-TERM bound E^{-1/2} A^{1/2} U V + h^{1/4} A U V^{1/2} + h^{1/4} E^{1/4} A^{3/4} U V^{1/2} + h^{1/4} E^{-1/4} A U^{3/4} V + h^{1/2} E^{1/4} A U^{3/4} V^{3/4} + h^{1/4} E^{1/4} A^{1/2} U^{3/4} V + h^{1/2} E^{3/4} A^{1/2} U^{3/4} V^{3/4}; the proof then SETS W = U^{1/4} to balance Type I (summation by parts + Weil bound for incomplete Kloosterman sums: (1+|w|) T^eps (A V^{3/2} W + A U V^{1/2}), parameter W << (N1/d h)^{1/3} free) and Type II, uses E^{-a} << U^{-a/4} (a < 0) and E^{b} << U^{b/2} (b > 0), keeps track that IN EACH TERM THE POWER OF h IS SMALLER THAN THE POWER OF U (U = N1/d h carries a hidden h; a positive power of h must remain in the denominator to sum over h | d**infty), and obtains T^eps/d (T^{1/2} N^{7/8} + N^{7/4}). The modulo variable v ranges over v ~ V with only coprimality conditions ((v,h)=1, (ef,v)=1) - NO prime/squarefree/smooth restriction, so an estimate valid for general moduli is applicable in principle.

THE PRECISE L1 TASK (named, for the next scoped attempt): substitute the Blomer-Pascadi / Pascal / 2601.00292 bounds into the PRZZ Type II sum in its exact parameter regime (EF ~ U, W = U^{1/4}, E, F in [W, U W^{-1}], v ~ V general modulus, h | d**infty), term-by-term against the seven-term DI bound; re-optimize W (the balance need not stay at U^{1/4} under a new estimate - the 'better balance W != U^{1/4}' lever of the 0303 menu); check the hidden-h constraint survives (each term: h-power < U-power); read off the improved (delta, delta2) on (7/4, 7/8) and apply machine LevWall7.wallUnderBothImprovements to compute the shifted wall 4/7 + min(8 delta/7, 4 delta2/7). The double-waste gate is the pass condition: a new Type II estimate that improves only the term feeding 7/4 (with the 7/8 term unimproved) moves NOTHING; both must move.

HONEST PRIORS: Deshouillers-Iwaniec Lemma 1 (1984) has stood for four decades; the new 2026 results improve specific regimes (critical length sqrt(c), composite moduli, incomplete sums) that MAY or MAY NOT intersect PRZZ's regime at a binding term. The realistic outcomes are: (a) a strict improvement in at least one binding term with the other term's exponent unaffected - NO wall movement (double waste), recorded as the exact obstruction to leveraging the new results; (b) both terms improved - wall moves, a genuine advance in the M2 lane (paper-worthy); (c) the new estimates need a different Type I/II decomposition. Outcomes (a) and (c) are BOTH legitimate machine-pinnable records of the same kind as 0302 (weighting SEALED) and 0304 (d-l is a kappa lever).

CONTEXT (proportion lane, face-blind by 0285/0292/0307 logic - recorded for completeness, does NOT touch the wall): the 2026-08 Alpoge-Furman arXiv:2608.13637 (unconditional N0(T) >= 2/3 simple-and-on-line, 5/6 distinct; 0.6725/0.8362 with the Montgomery-Taylor window) and Kintali's 42.1% marked-subset Levinson-Conrey (2026-08; its selector is what makes the DI seven-term system feasible PAST 4/7 for the proportion, per the 0307 primary reading) supersede the prior kappa records (PRZZ 41.7293...% 2020). These are proportion statements - the in-tree face is a zero-free statement above the frontier, not a proportion; no wire connects them to terminalFace in-tree.
